question: A trapezium has parallel sides of length 22 cm and 10 cm. The non-parallel sides are equal, each of length 13 cm . Find the exact height and area of the trapezium.
solution:

Parallel sides = 22 and 10

Non-parallel sides = 13

**Formula Used:**

Height from right triangle = √(side² − base²)

Area of trapezium = (1 ÷ 2) × (sum of parallel sides) × height
